bug_semantics: The authenticated PUT /admin/settings/users/edit/{id} route accepts an attacker-controlled user id, and UserController::update validates request fields but performs no object-level authorization tying that id to the acting user before passing attacker-controlled data to UserRepository::update. A low-privilege account with the users.edit ACL permission can therefore target another user's id, submit a new password (which is bcrypt-hashed), and take over or deactivate that account.
flaw_origin: The unsafe update sink already existed as unreachable controller code, but fc536cbc35cbd3e095379ae0934784b12f6b033e is the smallest causal introducer: it first registered Route::put('edit/{id}', 'UserController@update') beneath only the authenticated user middleware, making the attacker-controlled id reach the authorization-free password-update handler. Its direct parent still had UserController::update but no update route, so the reported HTTP attack path was absent.

reasoning: Field reconciliation 2026-08-29 (see evidence tail). The causal chain begins when fc536cbc35cbd3e095379ae0934784b12f6b033e exposes the pre-existing authorization-free update method as an authenticated PUT route with a user-controlled id. The direct parent contains the sink but not the route, proving that the reported network path begins at this ordinary one-parent commit rather than at a later move/refactor or the 2026 tested merge. The BIC predates v1.0.0 and is contained by v2.2.0; source comparison also disproves any implication that v2.2.1 is patched. Commit 97953fd3200b9c67e779b87c61f1846e0e430d4b is the first direct code fix because it enforces self-or-administrator authorization before update, but it was never tagged and af5deb595d81eb5cd94e1b1e372c61438e79f284 subsequently re-enabled password changes for peer/lower users. The exact BIC commit object has only a human author/committer and no AI marker, so the causal verdict is NOT_AI even though upstream currently lacks a durable released fix for the advisory's strict owner-or-admin requirement.
remaining_gap: No durable patched release currently exists: 97953fd3200b9c67e779b87c61f1846e0e430d4b briefly fixed the BOLA but is in no tag, and af5deb595d81eb5cd94e1b1e372c61438e79f284 re-enabled non-self peer/lower-user password edits before current HEAD 59eef05606f42cb661ff73bc98a0779cce4c584a.
